L4|error|`result` is an implicit global, so calls share and overwrite one table. Fix: declare `local result = {}`.
L6|warn|`v > 0` raises a Lua error for non-numeric values (string, table, boolean). Guard with `type(v) == "number"` or validate input.
L5|info|`ipairs` stops at the first nil, so later elements of a list with holes are silently dropped. Use `for i = 1, table.maxn(list)` or check the input has no holes.
